Scheduled - During this maintenance window, users will be unable to use their EPBC accounts to authenticate to the following UBC services:

* Applicant Service Centre (ASC)
* UBC's UNI CRM
* CWL Account Upgrader (CWLU): for CWL account creation

Users relying on EPBC credentials to sign in to these services will be unable to authenticate for the duration of the maintenance window. No action is required from users; access will resume automatically once maintenance is complete.

entry.title: UBCIT eSAM Servers Maintenance August 27, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Aug 27, 20:00 - 23:00 PDT

Aug 17, 10:53 PDT
Scheduled - UBCIT will be performing maintenance on the eSAM component and vault servers on August 27, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT. This change will affect both UBC campuses.

Users will intermittently not be able to login to any servers managed by eSAM, nor retrieve any credentials via the eSAM Web UI throughout the maintanance window.

Any connections terminated while a component is being rebooted can be reconnected to the secondary node. All connections will be terminated and users won't be able to reconnect while we patch the vault servers (which typically lasts around 30 minutes) during this window.

entry.content:

Investigating - Some Zoom users on Windows clients may have experienced a problem where Zoom requests to perform an update, but is unable to complete. This would prevent users from using the Zoom application to attend or schedule Zoom meetings until the update is completed.
